svg.text: SLIDE 02 // MATHEMATICAL SIGNAL RECOVERY PIPELINE
Four-Stage Deterministic 2D-to-1D ECG Waveform Reconstruction
STAGE 01 // SPECTRAL GRID CALIBRATION & DESKEW
Isolates terracotta red-minus-green grid channel G(x,y) = max(0, R - G)
• Column Autocorrelation Peak → Physical Pitch (px/mm)
• Radon Projection Variance over θ ∈ [-5°, +5°] → Deskew Angle
• Physical Scale Lock: 25 mm/s (40 ms/mm) & 10 mm/mV (100 µV/mm)
Δt_sample = 1 / 250 Hz = 4.0 ms | ΔV_pixel = 1 / (px_per_mm × 10) mV
AC Baseline Filter: Centers Holter DC Offset (>0.25 mV) to Midline
STAGE 02 // LOCAL ILLUMINATION & CHROMATIC SEPARATION
Suppresses uneven smartphone shadows and terracotta 1mm/5mm grid lines
• 25×35 Uniform Background Luminance Filter B(x,y) removes shadows
• Redness Suppression: R_grid(x,y) = max(0, R - 0.5·(G + B))
• Carbon Ink Likelihood Matrix I_ink(x,y) isolates broadband ink absorption
Result: +28.3 dB SNR gain on MIT-BIH #112 Smartphone Shadow Strip
STAGE 03 // GLOBAL VITERBI DP CONTINUITY TRACKER
Solves exact global dynamic programming path across all columns x = 1..W
• Huber Slew Penalty: Quadratic for small jitter, linear for steep R-upstrokes
• Sub-Pixel Parabolic Refinement around integer Viterbi path y*(x)
• Ignores isolated text labels ("II", "V2") & top barcode headers (+30.9 dB)
DP[y, x] = -2.4·I_ink(x,y) + min_Δy [ DP[y+Δy, x-1] + Φ_Huber(Δy) ]
Φ_Huber(Δy) = 1.8·min(|Δy|, 4)² + 1.15·max(0, |Δy| - 4)
Preserves 1.8 mV R-wave apex without corner clipping (SNR: 1.66 dB → 18.16 dB)
STAGE 04 // GTQI SAFETY GATE & PARABOLIC FIDUCIALS
Withholds intervals when trace quality cannot support clinical measurement
• GTQI = 0.25·Grid + 0.25·Contrast + 0.30·Continuity + 0.20·Slew
• Blank-Grid & Asystole Guard: Requires mean_ink ≥ 14 & ptp ≥ 0.15 mV
• Parabolic Q/R/S/T Delineation: HR (BPM), RR, PR, QRS, QT, Bazett QTc (ms)
IF GTQI ≥ 65 → Report Verified Intervals (QT MAE = 2.9 ms [2.02–3.90])
IF GTQI < 65 → WITHHOLD Intervals & Box Collision Region
Eliminates false long-QT alerts on Tier 5 colliding leads (100% neg control pass)
